reviews.evidence: Confirmed repeated membership: selected tags are shared across list rows. Construct one Set outside filtering and scan each row with Set.has. Preserve any/all modes, duplicate semantics, missing tags, category alternatives, order and item identity. No per-row Set allocation.

Confirmed: active legacy list-widget search treated visitor text as regex syntax. Escape metacharacters using canonical helper and construct one case-insensitive expression per invocation. Prevents syntax exceptions and unintended matches; ordinary text and category-or-text behavior preserved.

Rejected: href comes from getFontBasedOnSetting, which always uses https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2. Canonical recipe explicitly excludes Google Fonts URLs. Runtime tests verify the generated URL. DocumentGoogleFonts also retains cached-inline CSS and remote fallback behavior; CoreDecorator supports runtime CMS font selection. No production change or suppression.

Rejected for current workload: breakpoint intersection is bounded by the usual five theme breakpoint keys; caller uses this branch only when responsive keys are no more numerous. One million measured five-key/two-responsive-key calls: array 39.40ms versus Set including construction 74.42ms. Custom consumer themes may need reassessment if they have many breakpoints. Existing order/unknown-key/empty/scalar/array tests pass.

impact.membership: Scaling improvement for large tag-filtered lists. Local small workload shows negligible user-visible difference; not a claim of measured production latency improvement.
impact.regex: Search text such as ( previously could throw during list rendering; . previously matched arbitrary characters. Input now matches literally and case-insensitively.
impact.fonts: No violation of this rule: Google Fonts is explicitly excluded. External-font network/performance tradeoffs remain; no font-loading migration attempted.
